comparisons.peer_summary: Restructuring and other charges recognized in operating expenses were $1,533 million in fiscal year 2024 and $244 million in fiscal year 2023. The 2024 charges primarily consisted of employee termination costs related to cost reduction activities associated with the VMware Merger, while the 2023 charges were primarily non-recurring charges related to IP litigation.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom reported significant restructuring and other charges in fiscal year 2024, though the primary drivers differed. Intel recorded $780 million specifically for R2 litigation and $294 million for other streamline actions, alongside $3.1 billion in non-cash asset impairments. In contrast, Broadcom reported $1,533 million in restructuring and other charges, which primarily consisted of employee termination costs related to the VMware Merger, whereas its 2023 charges had been driven by IP litigation.

sentences.text: Litigation charges and other includes a charge of $780 million that we recorded in 2024 arising out of the R2 litigation.
Charges relating to other actions taken to streamline operations and to reduce costs were $294 million in 2024.
In addition, we incurred non-cash impairments relating to goodwill and acquired intangible assets of $3.1 billion in 2024.
Restructuring and other charges recognized in operating expenses were $1,533 million and $244 million in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
The fiscal year 2024 charges primarily included employee termination costs from cost reduction activities related to the VMware Merger.

comparisons.peer_summary: Fiscal 2024 other expenses included $107 million in restructuring charges, mostly severance, and a $75 million charge for settling a securities class action lawsuit.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Qualcomm disclosed specific litigation and restructuring charges within their fiscal 2024 operating results. Intel recorded a $780 million charge arising from R2 litigation and $294 million in streamline actions. Similarly, Qualcomm included a $75 million charge for settling a securities class action lawsuit in its other expenses, alongside $107 million in restructuring charges. While both companies faced legal-related costs, Intel's litigation charge was substantially larger relative to its restructuring costs compared to Qualcomm.
